title: The Timelessness of the Vishnu Sahasranamam
author: Vishnu Sreenivas
excerpt: The Divine Essence of Sri Vishnu SahasranamamIntroductionThe Sri Vishnu Sahasranamam, meaning "The Thousand Names of Lord Vishnu," is more than just a hymn—it’s a timeless spiritual guide for inner peace and clarity. For centuries, people have turned to it for comfort and direction in times of difficulty. But how did this sacred text originate?
